ratings_why.fun: Two halves (clock and brood) that Ottilie, Bellows and Rohrsang knot together give real build forks and many off-label combos, but the fight is heavy to track.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because the clock is shared: the enemy's own attacks advance your Chimes and your eggs live inside their units, so every fight is a timing and survival puzzle no current tribe or generic auto-battler has.

verdict_why: One real rules hole: Chime-effect attacks can trigger fresh strikes, so a Wind-at-every-Chime board chains strikes with no enemy turn.

points.text: Chime attacks don't count towards the clock, but the strike rule says 'at most once after each attack'. With Ottilie and three Winding Apprentices, each Little-Door Cuckoo Chime attack is followed by a new strike, which winds 3 again: a chain that runs the fight before the enemy acts. Say strikes come only after normal attacks.
Golden Kasimir with Ottilie lays twice at every Chime and pays per hatch: an egg economy worth building toward. Keep it hot, but the owner may want a cap like 'up to 3 gold'.
Mother Rohrsang with Red-Mouth gives three foster Chicks per friendly egg, each taking your host's keywords: a hidden Shield or Cleave factory. Worth listing as a build.
The Seven-Sleeper beside the Bellows grows +8/+8 a strike and is woken early by the all-dozing rule when it is the last unit standing; a fun last-stand line worth naming.
Weight-Hanger could also be Laid into by your own Rohrsang, so its death both winds and drops a foster Chick; a cheap way to make the T2 enabler matter late.

standouts.why: Ottilie re-runs every Start of Combat on the hour, turning Hens, Hawk and Apprentices into repeating engines.
Hawk-Barred Hen dozes and hosts the same enemy, and with Ottilie becomes the Lullaby lock.
Frau Wechselbalg copies the host: steal their carry, or with Rohrsang twin your own golden.

weakest.why: Pattern-Book Painter is a plain End of Turn Brood ticker with no decision.
Hour-Bird of the Tower is a generic team buff per Chime; strong but reads like any tribe's capstone.
Winding Apprentice alone is a vanilla body; it only matters stacked with Ottilie.

flags.note: Strikes can follow Chime-effect attacks; with Ottilie plus Apprentices winding 3 a Chime, the clock chains with no enemy action.
Bellows beside Herald of Spring gives every Clockwork +4/+4 permanently each fight.
Hawk-Barred Hen with Ottilie locks the enemy across for the whole fight; only killing the Hen frees it.
Golden Kasimir with Ottilie can pay several gold a turn.
Red-Mouth with Ottilie and several Hens is the stated runaway: many Heaves per strike.
